_notes: Interplanetary flight, frame by frame, recorded by running UQM's own ProcessShipControls, flagship_inertial_thrust, CheckShipLocation, CheckIntersect, FindRadius, enterInnerSystem, leaveInnerSystem, ValidateOrbits and flag_ship_preprocess, in the order IP_frame runs them (see tools/extract/golden/systems.c). After entering orbit, the ship returns to flight as EnterPlanetOrbit does (FreeSolarSys, LoadSolarSys, CheckZoomLevel, ResetSolarSys); the orbit itself is left out.

Sprite intersection (DrawablesIntersect) uses circles instead of UQM's content sprite masks: ship_radius for the flagship, 0 for UQM's one-pixel frame, planet_radius by planet image size index, junk_radius for the starbase and the Sa-Matra, in display pixels. The engine uses the same model until the content stage.
A test pilot chooses the input each frame (turn towards the goal, thrust when facing it); the engine's tests replay the recorded input. Input flags: 1 left, 2 right, 4 thrust.
start: [facing, ip_location x, y, ShipStamp x, y, zoom radius] on arrival from hyperspace.

frames: [input, facing, velocity dx, dy (GetCurrentVelocityComponents), ip_location x, y, ShipStamp x, y, zoom radius (SunDesc[0].radius), inner system planet or -1, WaitIntersect, event] after each frame. Events: 0 none, 1 zoom, 2 entered an inner system, 3 left it, 4 entered orbit (and came back), 5 left the system.
